task.question: Who inaugurated the Noida International Airport in India in March 2026?
task.evidence: 28 March – The Noida International Airport is inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

answer: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the Noida International Airport on March 28, 2026. FINAL: Narendra Modi

[Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/DWgCjgACVne?hl=en) PM Modi inaugurates Noida International Airport Prime Minister Narendra Modi on March 28, 2026, inaugurated Phase I of the Noida International Airport, marking a major milestone in India’s aviation infrastructure. Located in Jewar, Uttar Pradesh, the airport becomes the second international airport serving the Delhi-NCR region, aimed at easing congestion at Delhi’s Indira Gandhi International Airport.
